# JSON dependency

Only the JSON adapter uses [nlohmann/json v3.12.0](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0).
The algorithm library has no external dependencies. The upstream single header
and MIT license are vendored unchanged so builds do not need network access.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

SHA-256 of `nlohmann/json.hpp`, matching the upstream release checksum:
`aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`.
